lesson: The system is consistently failing to distinguish between genuine liquidity sweeps and trend continuation, resulting in premature entries against the macro downtrend. Both long and short setups are being invalidated by volatility before structural confirmation, indicating an over-reliance on low-timeframe signals in a high-fear environment.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Market Structure Shift (MSS) on the 4H timeframe before executing any trade, ignoring all 15m/30m setups until the macro trend aligns.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less on LINKUSDT during high-fear market regimes.
